sprite.description: The sprite identifier for the item

location.description: Where the item's wear level is active. World, Inventory or Both. None if the item does not wear.

expiryseconds.description: The expiry for this item in seconds. Zero if no expiry.

active_only.description: If true the item only wears while it is actively being used (e.g. flute playing, broom flying).

consumable.description: Can the item be eaten or drunk.

damage_to_weapon.description: Wear damage this item inflicts on each weapon when the weapon is used against it.

axe_hits.description: Optional, plants only (item.plant.*). Number of axe hits needed to chop the plant down. Each hit reduces the plant's wear level by 1/axe_hits, so values above 1 need a wear location of world or both. Defaults to 1.

actions.description: List of actions available for this item

burn_action.description: Applied repeatedly, at its own tick interval, while the item is burning.

carry_action.description: Applied repeatedly, at its own tick interval, while the item is held in the player's inventory (e.g. a carried candle accumulating darkness fear over time).

consume_action.description: Applied when the item is consumed (eaten/drunk/used up).

destroy_action.description: Applied when the item's world entity is destroyed/removed. Optional reward.item: the item dropped when this plant is chopped down with an axe.

forage_action.description: Optional. Applied when the player forages the plant. With gloves only its side effects apply, not its stat changes. Optional reward.item: the item gained when this plant is foraged with an empty hand (added to inventory) or gloves (dropped next to the plant).

spawn_action.description: Applied when the item spawns (e.g. loot dropped by a destroyed grave or NPC).

proximity_action.description: Applied repeatedly, at its own tick interval, while the player is near the item and it is within the current screen view. Optional reward: exactly one of item or loot, dropped on a random free cell beside the item once the player is within reward.trigger_range.

sacrifice_action.description: Applied when the item is sacrificed at an altar. The item can only be sacrificed if this action has a reward, which must set exactly one of item, wealth or special.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of the action, each rolled independently every time the action is applied.

spawn_npc.description: Spawn an NPC at the action's source position.

trigger_range.description: Distance in blocks from the item that the player must be within before the NPC spawn is triggered.

max_instances.description: Max live NPCs spawned by each item instance, across all its actions. Further spawns are skipped. Omit for unlimited.

lightning.description: Lightning strike on a working lightning rod in view, otherwise the player.

movement.description: Affect player movement and/or NPC pathfinding. Must set at least one of player or npc.

player.description: Effect on the player's movement. Not yet executed.

npc.description: Effect on NPC pathfinding. repel: NPCs flee from the player until out of view. slow/drunk: not yet executed.

reward.description: Optional reward granted when the action is applied.

item.description: The item gained. Must be a valid item key. For sacrifice_action, the spawned item will replace player inventory.

wealth.description: The wealth gained (sacrifice_action only). Tools (axe, pickaxe, shovel) can only be sacrificed once spent.

special.description: A special altar effect (sacrifice_action only). altar: light an altar candle (relics). banish: banish ghosts or gain an extra life at a crypt altar (witches jar). crypt: unlock the crypt key (exit key). toxic_immunity: toxidromes can't increase for reward.tick seconds (St John's Wort).

loot.description: The loot sprite dropped (proximity_action only), e.g. sprite.crypt.loot.gold. Must be a valid sprite key.

trigger_range.description: Distance in blocks from the item that the player must be within before the reward drops (proximity_action only). Defaults to 1.

max_instances.description: Max drops over each item instance's lifetime, picked up or not (proximity_action only). Further drops are skipped. Omit for unlimited.

tick.description: How long (seconds) a timed special lasts, e.g. toxic_immunity.
